name: Stormwind Guard
summary: Across Elwynn and Redridge, the Stormwind Guard struggles to hold its ground. Political gridlock and distant campaigns leave scattered marshals short of aid as gnolls, orcs, and bandits press the kingdom's borders.

sections.title: Shield of the Crown
sections.body: The Stormwind Guard patrols the roads and watchtowers that bind the kingdom together. Appointed marshals defend the outlying settlements: Marshal McBride in Northshire Valley, Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, and Marshal Marris in Lakeshire. They gather recruits and keep order. Between posts such as Westbrook Garrison, they ride brown horses prized for their stamina.

sections.title: A Border Stretched Thin
sections.body: Since the Third War, the Guard has kept Elwynn Forest safe and quiet. In recent years, though, crisis has come. King Varian Wrynn has vanished, and the kingdom's standing army is tied down abroad, leaving regional garrisons with little aid. At Westbrook Garrison, Deputy Rainer struggles to hold the western border against Riverpaw gnolls and Defias thieves. Local commanders now depend on visiting adventurers for crucial security work and bounties.

sections.title: The Abandoned Territories
sections.body: Royal court decisions have deepened the Guard's crisis. Under Lady Katrana Prestor's influence, the kingdom judged Westfall too costly to garrison and withdrew its troops. Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood then seized the region. Duskwood met the same fate. Soldiers were withdrawn, to Darkshire's despair, and abandoned locals formed the ragtag Night Watch to defend themselves.

sections.title: The Siege in the East
sections.body: The crown kept a tenuous military presence in the Redridge Mountains, even as Duskwood and Westfall were abandoned. The Guard's position there is desperate. Shadowhide gnolls and Blackrock orcs from the Burning Steppes overwhelmed the soldiers and drove them from Stonewatch Keep. In Lakeshire, blacksmith Verner Osgood uses iron to keep guards equipped. Exhausted sentries watch the road for the 2nd Battalion, which never arrives.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Stormwind Guard and the City Guard?
faq.answer: The Stormwind City Guard polices the capital within its walls. The Stormwind Guard defends the crown's outer territories, with regional garrisons patrolling roads and holding watchtowers across Elwynn Forest and Redridge.

faq.q: Why aren't there any Stormwind Guards in Westfall?
faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor's counsel on state expenses influenced the royal court to judge Westfall too costly to garrison, so all official troops withdrew. Without military protection, Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood quickly overran the territory's farms and roads.

faq.q: Why did the guard leave Duskwood?
faq.answer: Royal garrisons left Duskwood as resources dwindled. With crown protection gone amid rising dark magic and horrors, Darkshire's townsfolk formed the Night Watch to survive.

Appointed regional marshals lead local defense. Marshal McBride oversees Northshire Valley, Marshal Dughan commands the forces centered in Goldshire, and Marshal Marris directs Lakeshire's desperate defense in the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why are the guards in Lakeshire in such bad shape?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs and local gnolls drove the Redridge garrison from Stonewatch Keep. Trapped in Lakeshire, the guards lack equipment, and blacksmith Verner Osgood uses nearly all available iron to rearm sentries. They wait for reinforcements promised by royal leaders, but those reinforcements are delayed.
Marshal Haggard is a retired commander who once led the Stormwind Guard in calmer days. Back then, off-duty soldiers could travel south to drink together at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire.

angles.text: The Stormwind Guard is the kingdom's front line. Its abandoned sister settlements reveal deep political cracks threatening the heart of the Alliance.
As a human of the southern farmlands, you may know the guard's blue tabards as a sign of safety. Their sudden absence in Westfall and Duskwood can feel like a bitter betrayal.
As a warrior, you may begin as a Northshire recruit and become a hardened veteran at Westbrook Garrison, marching with regional marshals against gnolls and bandits.
As a blacksmith, you know a garrison depends on its armor. In places like Lakeshire, local smiths use entire iron reserves just to keep blades and shields serviceable.
